_comment: `gnomon compliance pack --out <dir>`: the evidence pack, manifest schema gnomon.evidence_pack/1
(docs/CONTRACTS.md §51). A part or file added or renamed, a manifest key renamed or an exit moved
is a contract change: packages/gnomon-cli/src/pack.test.ts asserts these lists against a real pack.

exit_codes.0: written (pack), or every file matches its hash (--verify)
exit_codes.2: --verify: a file is missing or does not match its hash
exit_codes.10: could not run: no .gnomon/, no --out, an --out that is not empty or is inside the surface, no pack.json to verify

optional_files.audit/trails/<trail>.jsonl: with --with-trails: each trail in the audit directory, copied
optional_files.evals/<path>/report.json: every eval and trial report under .gnomon-trials/

never: the pack never says compliant and carries the catalog's disclaimer; it changes nothing in the project
